_comment: The eight farm animals.
WHY HAND-AUTHORED. The Animals page keeps its colour tiers in image grids and
its actual facts in sentences: 'Female cows produce Milk every day, and male
cows produce Bull Horns every 3 days. With at least 8 Animalhearts, there is
a chance for the products to be Golden Milk...'. The item and heart tokens
inside those sentences are structured, but which product belongs to which sex
at which heart level is carried by the grammar. A parser would have to read
English to get it right, and getting it wrong would put Golden Milk on a bull.
Eight records, read once, each field sourced.
HEARTS. The wiki gives two thresholds: at 8 hearts a golden product becomes
possible, at 10 it is guaranteed. `hearts_required` records 8 — the point
from which it can happen at all — because that is the number a player plans
around. The certainty at 10 has nowhere to live in the schema yet and is not
invented into one.
SEX. Cows, chickens and ducks produce different things by sex (Milk vs Bull
Horns). The schema has no sex field, so both products are listed against the
animal. That is true — a cow herd produces both — and inventing a field for
it can wait until something needs to query on it.
MATURATION AND BREEDING (Animals page, 'Obtaining Animals'): coop animals
take 3 days to mature, barn animals 5. All babies arrive 4 days after their
parents were bred, and breeding needs both parents at 2+ hearts.
TREATS ARE PER SPECIES. The prose says 'Heart Shaped Treats', but the item
list has ten of them — Heart Shaped Cow Treat, Heart Shaped Duck Treat, and
so on. The specific one is recorded, since that is what a player has to buy.
PRICES are the Tier 1 (cheapest colour) adoption price from Hayden's Shop.
Tiers 2-6 cost proportionally more and depend on which colours the player has
unlocked through breeding, which is player state rather than game data.
FEED (Animals page + Ranching): coop animals eat Grass Seed, barn animals eat
Hay, and both accept the milled feeds of their size. There is no plain 'Small
Animal Feed' item — the milled ones start at Quality.
